job.titel: SAP BRIM – Focus on SOM / CI / FI-CA + SD / FI
job.beschreibung:
Location: Europe (any)
We are seeking a results-driven SAP Revenue Management & Quote-to-Cash Expert with deep experience on SAP’s standard Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) offering focused on Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Invoicing (CI) and Contract Accounting (FICA). Leveraging your subject matter expertise, you will provide perspectives on leading practices, alternatives and recommendations while also assisting in key functions involving training and on-going client support. You’re as comfortable leading projects as you are diving into the details of workstreams and configuring SAP solutions. Additional expertise in traditional Order-to-Cash (SD) and/or Finance (FI-CO) is required to round out your profile
What’s in it for you?
This an opportunity to join a European team of senior SAP experts with a focus on “thought leadership, origination, sales and delivery of large transformation SAP programs across industries”
Unmatched opportunity to work with top industry clients through human centric design, change management and innovation.
Be supported to continue your SAP training and certifications – complimented with other Accenture Engineer & Architecture training initiatives
Key Responsibilities:
Lead SAP BRIM workstreams with focus on SOM / CI / FI-CA across all phases of the project lifecycle
Advise clients on how to best leverage the BRIM solution to meet their business objectives and build state-of-the-art solutions
Define system architecture solutions for SAP BRIM implementations and act as the go-to expert for all questions related to the SOM / CI / FICA features and capabilities, as well as the S/4HANA BRIM roadmap.
Lead and facilitate Explore phases with business workshops and “show and tell” Conference Room Pilot sessions, demonstrating system functionality, highlighting key insights regarding leading practices while illustrating where business process align.
Analyze business requirements and blueprint/architect solutions using SAP BRIM that meet the client’s requirements
Conduct user story grooming sessions and facilitate requirements gathering, functional and technical design, configuration, prototyping, integration with other applications
Depending on project needs, use your knowledge in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash, Pricing, and Condition Technique), SAP FI (AR/AP) and/or SAP CPQ.
#LI-EU
Priority Skills and Basic Qualifications
Strong experience in SAP BRIM SOM / CI / FICA
Must have independently implemented SAP S/4HANA BRIM (SOM/CI/FICA) including functional design and configuration
Successful completion of S/4HANA project involving the mentioned SAP BRIM modules
Must have a secondary skill in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash, Pricing, and Condition Technique) and/or SAP Finance (FI-CO)
Strong background and experience with subscription and consumption-based monetization models
Experience with BRF+ and, ideally, Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC) is considered a strong advantage.
External client-facing consulting experience
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
